mvp_limitations: No arbitrary Python execution
No generated Python renderer plugin in MVP
No live database querying
No Power BI replacement
No unrestricted chart generation
No internet requirement except local Ollama API
No Graphviz dependency in MVP
Recipe remapping is basic in Sprint 5.
Image-based look-and-feel extraction is future capability.
Advanced brand/template management is future capability.
Embedded web preview may fall back to browser.
SVG/PNG export is limited in Sprint 6.
Recipe field remapping is basic.
Offline renderer assets must be bundled or present under assets/vendor.
Image-based style extraction is future.
Packaged builds rely on bundled templates, assets, KB files, and graph matrix data.
HTML export is browser-oriented and does not yet produce PDF or Office formats.
Recipe remapping is deterministic and limited.
Complex semantic remapping may require manual confirmation.
Recipes do not contain executable code.
Recipes preserve style intent but do not yet support full theme profiles.
Style profiles are deterministic configuration, not image-based theme extraction.
Style profiles support a limited renderer-safe font set and validated colour values.
Style profiles are currently scoped to charts and flowcharts.
Image style extraction is approximate.
Image style extraction does not recreate chart layout or data.
Image style extraction does not identify exact fonts.
Image style extraction does not perform OCR.
Image style extraction does not guarantee brand compliance.
Vision-model interpretation is optional and depends on local Ollama capability.
Deterministic palette extraction is the fallback.
Vision model detection is heuristic only — a matching name does not guarantee vision support.
Extracted styles are approximate and require user review before applying to production charts.
Exact fonts and chart layouts are not extracted from images.
Style comparison is based on deterministic heuristics, not perceptual similarity.
Built-in styles cannot be overwritten by import.
Recipe default styles are stored as IDs; if the style is deleted the ID becomes stale.
Style profiles are not executable code and cannot trigger renderer-level injections.
